items.title: Kolkata Metro Orange Line to Become Driverless Once the Stretch Extends till Sector V

items.title: Why your monthly grocery bill is rising: Onion prices jump 116%, garlic 61% as South India feels inflation heat
items.summary: Rising food prices are putting pressure on household budgets, with onion inflation at 116% and garlic at 61% in October. All five southern states recorded retail inflation above the national average of 6.09%, adding to the cost of everyday expenses.
